entry: effect.ts[KD9L]: F:维护全局活动订阅者，执行副作用并管理依赖收集与清理 | R:code:packages/reactivity/src/dep.ts,code:packages/reactivity/src/computed.ts,code:packages/reactivity/src/effectScope.ts | A:ReactiveEffect,EffectFlags,activeSub,effect | S:activeSub 在 run 里存旧值并在 finally 恢复，嵌套 effect 才归属正确；RUNNING 且未开 ALLOW_RECURSE 时 notify 直接丢弃，防自触发
